CustomField.description: Set to TRUE by GuestSchedulerController.bookAppointment after a successful IC rebook (i.e. the family used IC_Reschedule_Link__c to book a new SA against this Lead). Lets reporting / admin views distinguish leads who recovered from a cancellation vs. leads who stayed canceled. Also acts as a single-use guard — lookupLeadByRebookToken refuses to resolve a Lead whose IC_Meeting_Rescheduled__c is already true.
CustomField.label: IC Meeting Rescheduled
